# CMB Crisis Intervention Unit
## Under Construction This page is still being written. Until then, here is the unit's lore primer.
[italic]The Colonial Marshals Bureau Crisis Intervention Unit (CMB CIU) is a specialized unit of deputies and marshals tasked with responding to hostage situations, worker strikes, terrorist incidents, and any other high-profile crisis serious enough to require intervention beyond the capabilities of local law enforcement.[/italic]
